about.heading: About Me
about.subtitle: The Story and Journey
paragraphs: My name is Md. Nazrul Islam. I grew up with a passion for Islamic education from an early age. My educational journey began with completing the full memorization (Hifz) of the Holy Quran at a Maktab.

I then went on to study continuously in the Kitab (advanced Islamic studies) department, while also gaining proficiency in English. By the boundless mercy of Allah, I was also blessed with the opportunity to perform the sacred Umrah.
I am currently residing in Egypt, pursuing higher education at Al-Azhar University. I continue my studies regularly with the goal of acquiring Islamic knowledge.

highlights.title: Performed the Sacred Umrah
highlights.description: By the boundless mercy of Allah, I had the fortune of traveling to Saudi Arabia to perform the sacred Umrah, staying there for about seven days to complete the pilgrimage.

highlights.title: Moved to Egypt for Higher Education
highlights.description: Currently residing in Egypt and pursuing higher education at Al-Azhar University, continuing my studies regularly with the goal of acquiring Islamic knowledge.

stages.description: Completed the full memorization (Hifz) of the Holy Quran at the Maktab.
Completed studies from the beginning of the Kitab department up to Nahmir.
Completed the study of the Hedayatun Naho text.
Successfully completed an English language course.
Currently residing in Egypt, pursuing Islamic higher education with regular studies.
